findings.passage: “We need to have that conversation,” she said. “There has to be accountability for both kids and adults. And one thing we know is what we’re doing isn’t working, so that’s one area I imagine we’ll try to address as quickly as possible.”
findings.note: Quoted by Charleston City Paper's Statehouse Report by phone, as a member of the House committee on youth gun violence. She agreed with a police chief's concern about adults leaving guns in unlocked cars, where teens take them, and said adults need accountability as well as kids. She also named gun crime sentencing as something the committee might look at.
